title: OAuth 2.0 Simulation
description: Simulate the OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow with token exchange, protected resources, and refresh tokens.

steps.title: Authorization endpoint
steps.description: Create a GET /oauth/authorize endpoint that accepts a client_id and redirect_uri query parameters, and returns an authorization code.
hints: Generate a random authorization code using crypto.randomBytes
Store the code in memory mapped to the client_id and redirect_uri
Return the code in JSON: { code: '...' }

steps.title: Token exchange endpoint
steps.description: Create a POST /oauth/token endpoint that accepts the authorization code, validates it, and returns an access token.
hints: Accept grant_type, code, and client_id in the request body
Validate that the code exists in authCodes and is not expired
Generate a JWT-like access token and return { access_token: '...', token_type: 'Bearer' }

steps.title: Access protected resource
steps.description: Create a GET /oauth/resource endpoint that accepts a Bearer token in the Authorization header, validates it, and returns the protected resource data.
hints: Verify the JWT token signature and extract the payload
Return the user data from the decoded token: { userId, client_id }

steps.title: Invalid or expired token handling
steps.description: Ensure that /oauth/resource returns 401 for invalid tokens (wrong signature) and expired tokens (exp claim in the past).
hints: Check the token's 'exp' claim and reject if expired
Verify the HMAC signature — tampered tokens must be rejected
Test with a token that has an expired 'exp' timestamp

steps.title: Refresh token flow
steps.description: Add a refresh token to the token response. Create a POST /oauth/refresh endpoint that accepts a refresh_token and returns a new access token.
hints: Generate a refresh token (random hex string) alongside the access token
Store refresh tokens in memory mapped to the user/client
The /oauth/refresh endpoint validates the refresh token and issues a new access token
Rotate refresh tokens: invalidate the old one and issue a new one
